name: Subtle Factual Update
description: Can the system detect a subtle correction and use the updated information?

conversation.content: Our API handles about 10,000 requests per second.
That's solid throughput. What's your infrastructure like?
We run on 8 EC2 instances behind an ALB. Each instance handles about 1,250 rps.
Good distribution. Are you seeing any bottlenecks?
Some. We just deployed new optimizations and re-measured. Turns out we're actually doing 15,000 rps now, not 10,000. My earlier number was from last month's metrics.
Nice improvement — 50% increase! The optimizations clearly paid off.
Yeah. We also scaled to 12 instances now to handle growth.
Smart to scale proactively. That's about 1,250 rps per instance still.
How many requests per second does our API handle, and across how many instances?

query: What is the current API throughput and instance count?
